introduction: Daniel (Matt Fichtemaier) has serious mother complex issue; as a result, his first relationship starts at the age of 17, and only because his girlfriend May (Airen Delamater) remains him of his mother Amanda (Andrea Leigh). His father Frank (Michael Kennealy) suffers from impotency, therefore he`s ashamed to continue this relationship with his wife. There is a point of life, a kind of predestination is existing between Amanda and Ray (Pascal Yen-Pfister) who is the father of May. As a complicated relationship develops during Daniel`s 18th birthday party, the celebration is like a ceremony, a funeral, a rebirth and a destiny.
